findings.summary: U3 pin TMR (TMR) missing pull-up resistor
findings.description: Pin TMR on U3 (BQ24074RGTR) is connected to net TMR but has no pull-up resistor. This pin type typically requires an external pull-up to a power rail for correct operation.
findings.recommendation: Add a 4.7k-10k pull-up resistor from TMR to the appropriate power rail.

fix_params.basis: Pin TMR is open-drain/input type requiring pull-up

report_context.impact: Pin may float or bus may not function without pull-up

text_annotations.text: 45 x 45 mm, 4 layers; protected 1S cell; USB-C charging; BLE batches <=1 s target
Read DESIGN_SPEC.md and DESIGN_REPORT.md before prototype assembly.
Only connect electrodes when running from battery; USB/programming requires electrode removal.
RA/LA/LL and V1-V6: TVS -> 2x100k -> low-leakage clamp -> C0G -> AFE.
All C0G capacitors 50 V. Match total input capacitance during CMRR verification.
RL: 2x499k series output limit. No defibrillator or electrosurgical protection.
START pin low: use SPI START/STOP commands. Keep unused GPIO inputs.
Internal VREF=2.4 V, GAIN=6; 500 SPS monitoring (sinc response is not flat to 150 Hz).
Firmware: LDO mode, calibrated LFRC; no external DCC/DEC4 network.
32 KiB RAM ring, batch every 250 ms; measured payload target >=200 kbit/s.
Maximum 1 s data-age target requires compatible central and bounded radio retries.
USB-C CHARGING / POWER PATH / DUAL LOW-NOISE LDO
100 mA USB input limit; 102.77mA nominal ISET programming, limited by input/load.
Protected 500 mAh 1S pack with thermally coupled 10k NTC is mandatory.
USB PGOOD diode forces AFE power-down. This is an acquisition interlock, not isolation.

top_issues.summary: U3 pin TMR (TMR) missing pull-up resistor
top_issues.description: Pin TMR on U3 (BQ24074RGTR) is connected to net TMR but has no pull-up resistor. This pin type typically requires an external pull-up to a power rail for correct operation.
top_issues.recommendation: Add a 4.7k-10k pull-up resistor from TMR to the appropriate power rail.

fix_params.basis: Pin TMR is open-drain/input type requiring pull-up

report_context.impact: Pin may float or bus may not function without pull-up
